route_gates.reason: Florida and California each retain camera and GPS channels, with spring/summer/fall/winter files for both methods
all GPS seasonal headers retain Indiv_ID, Fix_DateTime and X/Y; the Florida automatic failure is a matcher false negative caused by the two-character substring guard, not missing schema

all camera headers retain LocationName plus event-time fields; public methods define fixed 44-camera Florida and 48-camera California arrays with network exposure windows Dec 2015-Dec 2016 and Mar 2015-Mar 2017 respectively. No site-specific outage log is exposed, so this pass is limited to relative diel shape and cannot be reused as a standard E5 deployment-effort pass

Florida GPS May 2015-Feb 2017 overlaps the camera interval Dec 2015-Dec 2016; California GPS Sep 2015-Aug 2017 overlaps the camera interval Mar 2015-Mar 2017. Both overlaps cover all four predeclared seasons
requires a separate response-free algebraic identification proof for relative D(t) under the route normalization
model/kernel construction and transfer statistic are not yet frozen

outcome_exposure_audit.consequence: A1-A4 remain response-blind. Any A5/A6 choices must be theorem-based or mechanically inherited from public methods/code and may not be tuned to the published direction. A future empirical result must not be described as fully untouched preregistered validation.
